stories.title: HMRC Updates Making Tax Digital for Income Tax Guidance
stories.summary: HMRC published updated guidance for taxpayers who have been signed up for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax, clarifying what steps are required. The guidance page was updated on 24 August 2026.

stories.title: HMRC Scrutinises Landlords' Tax Records
stories.summary: HMRC is writing to landlords after cross-referencing data from tenancy deposit schemes and other sources, as part of a campaign targeting undeclared rental income. Letters were issued during August 2026.

stories.title: HMRC Publishes Updated STBV Compliance Guidance
stories.summary: HMRC released new guidelines clarifying its expectations of employers whose workers travel to the UK on a short-term basis, helping firms better manage their Short-Term Business Visitor payroll obligations.

stories.title: Woman Stranded in Spain After eVisa System Mistakes Her for Twin Sister
stories.summary: A UK resident was left stranded in Spain after the Home Office's eVisa system confused her digital immigration record with that of her identical twin sister. The incident has renewed criticism of the reliability of the eVisa rollout.

stories.title: UK Announces Further Sanctions in Support of Ukraine
stories.summary: The FCDO confirmed the UK has announced additional sanctions as part of ongoing efforts to support Ukraine, with promises of further measures in the weeks and months ahead. The announcement followed Prime Minister Burnham's visit to Kyiv.

stories.title: DWP Confirms 11 Benefits to Be Paid Early for August Bank Holiday
stories.summary: The DWP has confirmed that payments for 11 benefits — including Universal Credit, PIP, and the State Pension — originally due on 31 August (bank holiday Monday) will instead be paid early on Friday 28 August.

stories.title: Barnsley Residents to Receive Practical AI Training to Help Find Work
stories.summary: Two new DWP-backed schemes will launch in Barnsley, offering residents practical AI skills training — covering areas such as using AI to apply for jobs and prepare for interviews — as part of broader efforts to use technology to tackle unemployment.

agencies.name: DEFRA
agencies.description: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs

stories.title: Zoos and Attractions Remain Open Despite Bluetongue Outbreak
stories.summary: DEFRA confirmed that zoos and visitor attractions can remain open following a bluetongue disease outbreak, stating there is no risk to human visitors. The disease, which affects livestock, has prompted heightened biosecurity measures across farms.

stories.title: Police Warn of Consequences as Fly-Tipping Remains Environmental Threat
stories.summary: Police have issued renewed warnings about fly-tipping, highlighting its serious environmental impact including contamination of water courses and groundwater. DEFRA has been working with enforcement agencies since February to crack down on illegal dumping.

stories.title: PRiF Publishes Annual Report for 2025
stories.summary: The Expert Committee on Pesticide Residues in Food (PRiF), operating under DEFRA, has published its annual report for 2025, providing data on pesticide residue levels found in UK food samples.

stories.title: UK to Use Ukraine Battlefield Data to Train AI for Site Protection
stories.summary: The UK has agreed to access Ukraine's Avengers AI Labs data — drawn from real battlefield conditions — to train artificial intelligence systems designed to protect sensitive UK infrastructure and sites. The deal was announced during PM Burnham's Kyiv visit on 24 August.

stories.title: Defence Secretary Champions Innovation at Largest Navy Base in Western Europe
stories.summary: Defence Secretary Wes Streeting visited the largest naval base in Western Europe alongside Armed Forces Minister Luke Pollard to champion innovation in defence capabilities and highlight new technological investments in UK naval operations.

stories.title: New UK-Ukraine Partnership to Develop Battle-Winning Technology
stories.summary: The UK and Ukraine have announced a landmark partnership to jointly develop advanced defence technologies, including securing UK access to Ukraine's Avengers AI Labs, combining Ukrainian battlefield experience with UK research and development capacity.
stories.source: GOV.UK (Prime Minister's Office / Ministry of Defence)

agencies.name: BIST
agencies.description: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

stories.title: UK Launches Call for Evidence on UK-Morocco Procurement Agreement
stories.summary: BIST has opened a call for evidence seeking input on negotiating a new government procurement treaty chapter within the existing UK-Morocco association agreement, which would expand UK businesses' access to Moroccan public contracts.

stories.title: Report on Indirect Cost Compensation Payments to UK Industry Published
stories.summary: BIST published its annual report on indirect cost compensation payments made to industry in the UK in 2023–24, providing transparency on government support for energy-intensive industries facing carbon costs.

stories.title: UK-Ukraine AI Technology Partnership Announced (BIST/DSIT Dimension)
stories.summary: The former DSIT (now merged into BIST) co-announced a UK-Ukraine partnership to develop battle-winning AI technologies, with BIST supporting the science and innovation dimension of the deal through access to Ukraine's Avengers AI Labs.

stories.title: Over a Quarter of NHS Staff Lose 10+ Hours Per Week to Admin
stories.summary: A new survey by NHS Shared Business Services found that more than one in four NHS staff lose over 10 hours a week to administrative tasks, highlighting significant productivity losses and calling for digital transformation to free up clinical time.

stories.title: Virtual Wards See 51% Patient Increase in 2025-26
stories.summary: NHS Cheshire and Merseyside reported a 51% increase in patients benefiting from virtual wards — where hospital-level care is delivered at home — during 2025-26, as part of a national push to reduce in-hospital pressures and improve patient experience.

stories.title: NHS Trusts Celebrate Shortlists at HSJ Patient Safety Awards
stories.summary: Multiple NHS trusts have been shortlisted for five categories at the prestigious HSJ Patient Safety Awards, recognising innovative work to improve safety culture, reduce harm, and strengthen patient outcomes across the health service.
